title: Integrating Spatial Multi-Omics and Machine Learning to Unravel the Role of PANoptosis in Bladder Cancer Prognosis and Immunotherapy Response
summary: Primary article reports multi-omics and ten-ML-algorithm work identifying bladder-cancer PANoptosis subtypes and a prognostic signature. External cohorts support survival associations; immunotherapy response is computationally inferred. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center; Fudan University

evidence.tested: Primary article reports multi-omics and ten-ML-algorithm work identifying bladder-cancer PANoptosis subtypes and a prognostic signature. External cohorts support survival associations; immunotherapy response is computationally inferred.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: transcriptomic/spatial data, subtype analysis and ten ML algorithms for the PANoptosis prognostic signature.
